item.title: White House crypto council chief Patrick Witt steps down
item.description: Witt’s departure leaves a leadership gap at the White House Crypto Council and marks the fourth high-profile exit from the advisory group.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Starknet opens vote on potential Ethereum L2 exit over quantum risks
item.description: Starknet is asking STRK holders whether to explore becoming an independent layer-1 blockchain to reduce its dependence on Ethereum’s quantum-security upgrade timeline.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Bitget, Liquid exploits push Q3 crypto hacks toward $1.2B
item.description: Compromised suppliers, developer tools and infrastructure components outside security audits drove about 77% of the quarter’s total losses, according to Hacken.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Bitcoin dips to $80.1K as KOSPI closes at its lowest since April
item.description: Bitcoin price action continued to see contagion from a Korean tech sell-off after the KOSPI Index fell 7.5% on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Thailand crypto ETFs may see slow start despite new rules: CoinShares
item.description: Thailand’s new Bitcoin and Ether ETF rules take effect Friday, but CoinShares expects modest initial inflows as existing investment options compete for demand.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Babylon advances native Bitcoin lending proposal on Aave V4
item.description: Babylon’s proposal to bring native Bitcoin collateral to Aave V4 has entered a new governance stage, but further votes and security reviews remain before launch.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $261M as XRP funds buck weekly outflow trend
item.description: Bitcoin ETFs have recorded $151 million in net outflows since Monday, after investors withdrew $681 million the previous week.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: South Korea plans cybersecurity overhaul after attacks hit banks, crypto firms
item.description: South Korea is proposing tougher cybersecurity assessments after a review identified security deficiencies at 130 financial firms.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Australia seeks feedback on crypto platform rules ahead of 2027 rollout
item.description: The consultation follows Parliament’s passage of digital asset legislation in April, with Australia’s securities regulator now proposing capital, custody and trading standards for crypto platforms.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Bitcoin miners plunge up to 13% in Wall Street’s worst selloff since July
item.description: TeraWulf, Core Scientific, Cipher Mining and IREN each lost more than 12% as hotter inflation hit AI infrastructure companies.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: VanEck seeks to withdraw application for Lido staked Ether ETF
item.description: VanEck initially filed an S-1 registration statement for the exchange-traded fund in October last year.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Polygon gains US payments licenses after closing Coinme deal
item.description: The deal gives Polygon access to 37 money transmitter licenses and 11 state exemptions.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Organizations join forces to fight Illinois crypto tax, after 6-month pause
item.description: Illinois officials already agreed to delay implementation of a 0.2% tax on crypto assets, but industry-aligned organizations are pushing for summary judgment on the merits.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: EU authority classifies Circle’s USDC as ‘significant’ under MiCA
item.description: The second-largest stablecoin by market cap will be overseen by French and EU authorities under its classification as a “significant e-money token.“
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: US authorities dismantle crypto scam network that stole tens of millions
item.description: Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI seized 112 servers and shut down 241 websites linked to investment scams that targeted Russian-speaking Americans.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: OCC report finds debanking efforts tied to crypto activities
item.description: The report from the US banking regulator did not include specific examples of debanking related to crypto, but mentioned it alongside ties to oil, gas and firearms.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Standard Chartered pushes $2T stablecoin forecast to 2030 as transaction volumes grow
item.description: The bank identified four distinct stablecoin markets, with USDC leading payments and AI transactions as competition intensifies over reserve yields.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Bitcoin price dips below $82K as high oil prices spike US CPI inflation
item.description: Bitcoin fell below $82,000 while bond yields targeted new 24-year highs on the back of hot US CPI inflation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: ‘Bunker mode’ won’t protect your crypto, critics say
item.description: Even if Justin Drake’s prediction that AI could break cryptography proves correct, critics say “bunker mode” is an impractical suggestion that’s unlikely to protect your crypto.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Christina Comben

item.title: Canada crypto remittances to Asian countries surge 141% to $2.36B: Chainalysis
item.description: Remittance-sized crypto transfers from Canada to three Asian countries reached $2.36 billion, while transfers to the Philippines alone rose 28% to $61 million.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Qivalis wins Dutch e-money license for euro stablecoin
item.description: Qivalis said the Electronic Money Institution authorization enables it to launch a euro-denominated stablecoin, with issuance planned for the coming months, subject to additional MiCA requirements.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Kraken parent to buy Lithuanian Saldo Bank amid TradFi expansion
item.description: Payward expects to close the acquisition in 2027, enabling it to expand its traditional banking services into four EU operating markets already served by Saldo Bank.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Can crypto users trust the supply chain behind hardware wallets?
item.description: Ledger hardware wallet implants have renewed scrutiny of the middlemen handling devices before they reach buyers, even through authorized sellers.

item.title: Coins.ph says Philippine central bank license intact amid revocation claims

item.title: CryptoQuant’s 3 charts keeping Bitcoin’s ‘Uptober’ thesis valid

item.title: Standard Chartered expands Bitcoin and Ether trading to professional investors in UAE
